sources_considered.why: The original dated robot-jailbreak paper directly addresses the surrounding security concern while illustrating the limits of laboratory evidence for the societal claim.
The current abstract points to a November revision; the October 17 version was read and used instead.
The original research paper was available and preferred over the later explanatory post.

receipt.public_excerpt: Indeed, our results on the Unitree Go2 represent the first successful jailbreak of a deployed commercial robotic system.

evidence_items.explanation: The researchers demonstrate a concrete robot-security vulnerability relevant to Marcus's concern. The experiment does not identify the society-wide causal effect of empowering LLM companies or establish that society had almost no effective safeguards.

unresolved_gaps: There is no specified societal outcome against which success or failure can be scored.
There is no defined causal comparison connecting company empowerment and safeguard policy to that outcome.
